info.title: Rita Stock Opname API
info.description:
REST API untuk mendukung proses stock opname, pengelolaan produk, dan pemantauan hasil stock opname.

## Autentikasi

Seluruh endpoint wajib memakai cookie sesi `rita_session`, kecuali yang secara eksplisit ditandai `security: []` (endpoint publik di bawah). Tanpa cookie yang sah server menjawab 401.

Login memakai satu kredensial bersama untuk semua staf gudang. Setelah login, nama operator diketik bebas dan ikut tersimpan di dalam cookie. Nama itu dipakai sebagai aktor pada audit trail, tetapi **tidak diverifikasi**: yang didapat adalah pintu masuk terkunci plus jejak kebiasaan, bukan bukti identitas per orang.

Endpoint publik (dipakai aplikasi mobile dan probe):

- `POST /stockopname/coordinators/join-by-qr`
- `GET /stockopname/coordinators/{id}`
- `GET /stockopname/sessions/{id}`
- `GET /products`
- `GET /stockopname/racks`
- `POST /stockopname/uploads`

Keenam endpoint itu masih menerima header `X-Actor`, yang bisa dipalsukan sampai token join dikerjakan.

get.summary: Liveness probe
get.description: Mengembalikan 200 selama proses berjalan; database tidak diperiksa. Dipakai untuk memastikan container hidup, bukan untuk memastikan API bisa melayani. Request ke endpoint ini tidak ditulis ke access log.

get.summary: Readiness probe
get.description: Melakukan ping ke database dengan timeout 2 detik. 200 bila database menjawab, 503 bila tidak. Dipakai untuk memastikan instance siap menerima trafik setelah deploy.

patch.description: Update session status. Rejected with 409 for COMPLETED/CANCELLED sessions and for IN_PROGRESS -> COMPLETED when the session has no products.

delete.description: Hard delete. COMPLETED/CANCELLED sessions are always deletable; IN_PROGRESS only when it has no products and no stock opname results. All child rows (products, barcodes, results, racks, coordinators) are removed by cascade.

patch.description: Applies a -1, 0, or 1 qty factor to one item, selected items, filtered results, a rack, a coordinator, or a session. Effective quantity is quantity × qty_factor. Status final does not block this operation.

get.summary: Get all racks for a session or coordinator
get.description: Retrieve all racks. Use this list to delete unused racks. uploaded_at is the upload that last claimed the rack (the host); can_upload is true while the rack has no host and mirrors the upload guard, so clients should gate the upload button on can_upload instead of is_empty. item_count counts every result row in the rack and unowned_count counts only the rows that have no owning upload yet.

post.description: Upsert products + barcodes from a PRODUK.DBF ("produk") and BARCODE.DBF ("barcode") multipart pair. Idempotent. Use ?dry_run=true to validate without writing.
Removes all products and barcodes of one session. Requires ?sessionId=&confirm=true. Stock opname history is untouched.

delete.description: Rejected with 409 when the session is final, the rack was already uploaded, the rack has items, or it is the last rack of the coordinator.

post.summary: Join a coordinator by scanning its QR code
post.description: Validates the coordinator and returns its racks with upload status and live contents. item_count and is_empty describe the live rack contents; can_upload mirrors the upload guard (rak_upload_id IS NULL) and is what clients should use to enable the upload button. unowned_count tells the scanner how many rows the next upload of that rack will adopt. uploaded_at is the host upload: the one that last claimed the rack, cleared once it owns nothing there. There is no push notification: call this endpoint again to refresh. Join is only allowed while the coordinator status is IN_PROGRESS.

get.summary: List uploads that still own a result row
get.description: Returns every upload of the coordinator that still owns at least one result row. rack_count and item_count are counted from row ownership, so an item moved to another rack still counts for the upload that owns it. Uploads without any owned row are kept in the database but are not listed here. upload_number is computed over all uploads of the coordinator, so the numbers may have gaps.

post.summary: Submit a batch of racks as one upload
post.description: Creates one upload row grouping every rack in the batch. A rack can be claimed only while it has no host upload; when any rack already has one the whole batch is rejected with 409. Result rows that have no owner yet in the claimed racks are adopted by the new upload before the batch is written. Scanning a PLU that another upload owns in the same rack transfers that row to this upload and overwrites its quantity, because the rack is being re-counted. rack_count and item_count in the response are counted from ownership.

get.summary: Download the upload PDF for an upload batch
get.description: Rendered from the result rows owned by the upload, grouped by the rack each row currently sits in. An item moved to another rack is printed under its new rack, and racks without any owned item are omitted. Quantities use effective quantity (quantity x qty_factor). Set include_carton=true to add a Karton column (effective quantity divided by the product carton size).

post.summary: Move stock opname results to another rack
post.description: Moves all results of a source rack, or only the given result_ids, into a target rack in the same session. If the target rack already has the same PLU, quantities are merged.

get.summary: List stock opname audit entries
get.description: Returns administrative changes to stock opname results, newest first.

get.summary: List audit batch summaries
get.description: Returns one summary row per bulk audit action. Use GET /stockopname/audits?batchId=<uuid> for details.

get.summary: List audit entries as one timeline
get.description: Returns batches and single changes in one chronological list. A batch that only contains one row is returned as kind=single, so one-item work is never shown as a bulk action. Use GET /stockopname/audits?batchId=<uuid> to load the items of a batch.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Filter by action. Repeat the parameter or use comma separated values (UPDATE,MOVE).

id.description: Set for kind=single, including a batch that collapsed into one row.

factor_before.description: Set for kind=batch when every row shared the same previous factor.

source_rak_name.description: Set for kind=batch with action MOVE.

target_rak_name.description: Set for kind=batch with action MOVE.

merged_count.description: Number of moved rows whose quantity merged into an existing row.

post.summary: Tukar kredensial bersama dengan cookie sesi
post.description: Membuat cookie `rita_session` berisi sesi 12 jam dengan nama operator kosong. Aplikasi web baru bisa dipakai setelah nama operator diisi lewat `POST /auth/operator`. Sepuluh percobaan gagal dalam 5 menit dari alamat yang sama dijawab 429.

200.description: Login berhasil; cookie sesi dikirim lewat Set-Cookie

429.description: Terlalu banyak percobaan dari alamat yang sama

message.example: Terlalu banyak percobaan. Coba lagi beberapa menit.

post.summary: Simpan nama operator yang sedang bertugas
post.description: Nama diketik bebas (1-50 karakter, spasi berurutan dikecilkan, karakter kontrol ditolak) dan langsung ditulis ke cookie baru. Nama ini yang tercatat sebagai aktor audit sampai sesi berakhir.
Bisa dipanggil sebelum nama operator diisi. Cookie dikirim ulang dengan masa berlaku habis.

get.summary: Status sesi saat ini
get.description: Dipanggil SPA saat dibuka untuk memutuskan apakah perlu login. Selalu 200: cookie yang tidak ada atau tidak sah dijawab `authenticated: false`, bukan 401.

barcodes.description: Replaces the whole barcode set when present.

note.description: Optional correction note stored in the audit log.

uploaded_at.description: Upload that last claimed this rack (the host). Null when the rack has never been uploaded or its host was released.

item_count.description: Live number of result rows in the rack, whatever upload owns them.

unowned_count.description: Result rows in the rack that no upload owns yet; the next upload of the rack adopts them.

can_upload.description: True while the rack has no host. Same rule the upload endpoint enforces.

barcode.description: Scanned barcode. Either barcode or plu is required.

plu.description: Product PLU. Either barcode or plu is required.

note.description: Optional correction note stored in the audit log.

uploaded_at.description: Upload that last claimed the rack (the host). Cleared once that upload no longer owns any row in the rack.

item_count.description: Live number of result rows currently in the rack.

unowned_count.description: Rows in the rack that no upload owns yet; the next upload of the rack adopts them.

can_upload.description: True while the rack has no host; use this to enable the upload button.

is_empty.description: True when the rack has no live result rows.

rak.description: Racks owned by the coordinator. item_count and is_empty are live values for mobile; uploaded_at marks the upload the rack currently belongs to.

upload_number.description: Urutan upload per koordinator. 1 = upload pertama. Nomor dapat memiliki gap karena upload tanpa rak aktif tidak ditampilkan.

rack_count.description: Number of distinct racks that currently hold a row owned by this upload.

result_ids.description: Omit to move the whole source rack.

reopened_rack_id.description: Source rack whose upload was reopened because it became empty.

name.description: Nama bebas, dipakai sebagai aktor audit

operator.description: Kosong selama nama operator belum diisi
